name: Dun Garok
summary: Dun Garok guards the southeastern heights of the Hillsbrad Foothills. Captain Ironhill commands its dwarven garrison, which defends Alliance interests and nearby operations such as the Azurelode Mine. To the Forsaken of Tarren Mill, the stronghold is a military threat on their border.

sections.title: A Bastion in the Foothills
sections.body: Dun Garok holds the crags in the southeastern Hillsbrad Foothills. Captain Ironhill commands the Ironforge mountaineers and riflemen who defend the outpost. They guard human settlements in Hillsbrad and protect Alliance operations at the Azurelode Mine. Stone walls and deep entrenchments help the garrison hold against nearby threats.

sections.title: Target of Tarren Mill
sections.body: Dun Garok lies close to Tarren Mill, and the Forsaken see it as an intrusion on their southern border. Sylvanas Windrunner's forces resent the armed dwarven troops near their stronghold. They plot to enter the fortress, break its defenses, and kill Captain Ironhill's garrison to secure Forsaken control of Hillsbrad.

faq.answer: Dun Garok guards the southeastern mountains of the Hillsbrad Foothills as a fortified dwarven outpost. Its Ironforge troops defend Alliance holdings in the region.
Captain Ironhill commands Dun Garok's mountaineers and riflemen. They defend Hillsbrad and the nearby Azurelode Mine.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want to destroy Dun Garok?
faq.answer: The Forsaken see Dun Garok, near Tarren Mill on their southern border, as a security threat. They send agents to destroy the garrison.

faq.q: What is Dun Garok's strategic value to the Alliance?
faq.answer: Dun Garok helps the Alliance defend Hillsbrad and protect the nearby Azurelode Mine from hostile seizure.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can look to Dun Garok, where Captain Ironhill and his mountaineers defend their human allies and mark Ironforge's reach into Lordaeron.
As a member of the Horde, you face a well-defended dwarven enclave that threatens Forsaken security around Tarren Mill. Its garrison is a priority target.
